mecanismos.que: Receta vLLM para Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 en un Spark con MTP (sparkrun yaml)
mecanismos.como: vllm serve rdtand/Qwen3.8-27B-PrismaAQUA-5.5bit-vllm --max-model-len 262144 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.59 --max-num-seqs 4 --load-format fastsafetensors --attention-backend flashinfer --mamba-block-size 256 --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}' ... env: VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND=flashinfer-cutlass, VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=0, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1a, ENABLE_NVFP4_SM100=0
mecanismos.probado_en: Spark con reloj bajado a 2 GHz segun el autor; vLLM 0.27.2rc1.dev88; tool-eval-bench 93/100
mecanismos.riesgo: Valores copiados de una receta de 3.6; el autor dice que no optimizo

mecanismos.que: Receta alternativa vLLM 0.23.1rc1 con unsloth NVFP4
mecanismos.como: gpu_memory_utilization 0.35; speculative {"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}; --load-format instanttensor; --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3; --async-scheduling; env FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1, CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_121a

mecanismos.que: Receta SGLang de un solo Spark: 31.4 tok/s
mecanismos.como: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --attention-backend flashinfer --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --max-running-requests 10 --context-length 262144
